description: Usage of the web interface (only if the tenant switched usage tracking on): totals per feature id (with label and area from the registry), per route pattern (/app/leads/:id, with minutes on page), per day and per event kind (seite|funktion|formular|uebergabe|fehler|reibung) for a period, plus registry features with no use in the period. Never contains content (no text, field values, search terms or customer data) — only feature ids, route patterns, object refs, durations and counts. Optional filters: art, funktion (exact or prefix ending with '.'). je_person=true adds totals per person — ONLY for tenant admins and ONLY when the tenant enabled per-person tracking (personenbezogen); otherwise it fails. Default period: last 7 days. Admins, planners and agents.

bis.description: Until (YYYY-MM-DD = end of that day, or ISO). Default: now.

funktion.description: Feature id, or a prefix ending with '.' (e.g. 'asbest.')

je_person.description: Totals per person — tenant admins only, and only with per-person tracking enabled.

von.description: From (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO). Default: 7 days ago.

name: get_nutzung
